row.title: Supply-chain posture is a weekly loop on open standards
row.body: OpenSSF Scorecard and the SPDX SBOM from GitHub's dependency graph are read weekly by supply-chain.yml and summarised by foundation/supplychain.py; checks under the floor in doctrine/scorecard.json and packages outside the licence policy become Q-STD-SC-* items closed by the next reading. Settings were renamed from doctrine/open-standards.json to avoid COLLISION-1 with PR #2260, which owns that path.

title: Supply-chain posture is a weekly loop on open standards
